title: Article in Artists Network
content: Just published: a free onlinearticle in Artists Networkabout my approach to imaginative painting.The key is to "fill the bucket" with studies based on real life and three dimensional models.The print magazine is now available, too.Garden of Hopewill be on view at theHunter Museum in Chattanooga, Tennesseestarting on May 20, 2022.--Article in Artists Network
